additional_requirements.title: Ensure all aspects of the pipeline infrastructure and configuration are immutable
additional_requirements.text: Use an immutable pipeline orchestrator and ensure that its configuration and all other aspects of the built environment are immutable, as well.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure the build environment is logged
additional_requirements.text: Keep logs of the build environment. For example, use the .buildinfo file for Debian build workers. Also, store the logs in a centralized organizational log store.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure the creation of the build environment is automated
additional_requirements.text: Automate the deployment of the build environment.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure access to build environments is limited
additional_requirements.text: Restrict access to the build environment to trusted and qualified users.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure users must authenticate to access the build environment
additional_requirements.text: Require authentication to access the build environment and disable anonymous access.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure the build infrastructure is automatically scanned for vulnerabilities
additional_requirements.text: Set an automated vulnerability scanning for your build infrastructure.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure default passwords are not used
additional_requirements.text: For each build tool, change the default password.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure webhooks of the build environment are secured
additional_requirements.text: For each webhook in use, change it to secured (over HTTPS).

additional_requirements.title: Ensure minimum number of administrators are set for the build environment
additional_requirements.text: Set the minimum number of administrators in the build environment.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure each pipeline has a single responsibility
additional_requirements.text: Divide each multi-responsibility pipeline into multiple pipelines, each having a single responsibility with the least privilege. Additionally, create all new pipelines with a sole purpose going forward.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure build secrets are limited to the minimal necessary scope
additional_requirements.text: For each build tool, review the secrets defined and their permissions scope and change over permissive scopes to more restrictive ones based on the required access.
